submission.justification: R1 has the highest separation (4.713 sigma at 3 cm) but its ageing compliance is unverified (ageing_verified_R1 = 0). The ageing limit is a hard, irreversible requirement. R3 at 2 cm is the best alternative at 3.855 sigma, but its ageing is also unverified, so the 10% transparency-loss limit must be confirmed for R3 before this choice is relied on. If R1 is later shown to pass ageing, it would be the better performer.

requirements.evidence: R3 at 2 cm gives 3.855 sigma, the best R3 value. R1 reaches 4.713 sigma at 3 cm, so R3 is not the highest-separation option.
